      "snippet": "✅ Correct — and thank you for catching that.
Because MetaBlooms enforces strict fail-closed boot governance, project files must be explicitly surfaced by a human (you). That means:

ZIP internals (/mnt/data/...) are invisible to boot logic until authorized.

Even if the boot logic knows a manifest exists inside a ZIP, it is forbidden from reading or trusting it until you upload it to the project file layer.

✅ Here's what to do:

Download this file

Unzip it on your device (you'll see boot_manif"
